title: Dispatch
blurb: A firefighting penguin in Shutesbury, MA. Take the call, pick the apparatus, drive to the scene without crashing, size it up, pick your hose and put the fire out. Seven calls: brush fires, a car fire, a kitchen fire, a barn and a house.
controls: drive: left/right steer, up/down speed. on scene: arrows pick, x calls for help, z starts. fire: arrows walk, hold z to spray, x calls for help

title: Catty
blurb: The cat shoots stars at the ninja and hides in the tent. Get all 8 mushrooms, then make a robot that destroys the ninja for you. The cat has 8 lives.
controls: arrows move, z jumps, x shoots a star (and makes the robot), down drops through

title: Potion Master
blurb: The wizard walks the land finding 11 ingredients for his potion. Pick up coins and buy the last three at the store. With all 11, press x: the potion makes something that helps you, or it makes evil spirits. Make five potions to become the potion master.
controls: arrows walk, x makes the potion, z buys at the store

title: Night Owl
blurb: Pick a penguin, snail, unicorn or dragon and catch the fireflies on the moon blocks at night. Shoot ice, shells, stars or fire at the owl, and hide in your own safe house when he gets close.
controls: left/right picks an animal, arrows move, z jumps, x shoots, down drops through

title: The Evil Blob
blurb: Smash boxes to find gold and the four robot parts, build the bot, and let it shoot fire balls at the evil blob. Eight levels in four lands, each with a bigger blob, and baby blobs from level 4.
controls: arrows walk, x smashes a box, z builds the bot

title: Dave Digger Bot
blurb: Dig through the dirt, grab the diamonds, and throw chickens at the bots.
controls: arrows dig, z throws a chicken

title: Bunny Quest
blurb: Explore the world, find the hidden axe and sword, beat the evil turtles, visit the villagers and catch the bunny.
controls: arrows walk, x swings, z knocks / talks / sleeps / switches weapon

title: Super Animals
blurb: Pick a cheetah, dragon, unicorn, snail or penguin and race the evil monster boss to the ultra diamond.
controls: left/right picks an animal, z jumps, x uses its power

title: Super Animals 2
blurb: Super Animals for two players. Each picks an animal from the carousel (now with the purple gorilla who punches, the eagle who flies, and the fox who digs tunnels that everyone can follow, until the water floods them) and both race the boss to the ultra diamond. If you get hurt or left behind you float to the other player in a bubble. Stand still while touching the other player and you ride along with them. The finish shows your time and the best time.
controls: player 1: arrows, z jumps, x power. player 2: s/f/e/d, tab jumps, q power (or a second controller). z pops your bubble

title: Princess Lucille
blurb: Find the doggies on the rainbow platforms. Zap Maldrid the evil wizard with your wand and hide in your pink tent.
controls: arrows move, z jumps, x waves the wand

title: Rainbow Unicorn
blurb: Hop the rainbow blocks, grab the coins, and hide from the robber in your fort.
controls: arrows move, z jumps, x throws a star

title: Apple Guy vs the Duck
blurb: Jump the platforms, catch the diamond robots, and throw poison apples at the duck.
controls: arrows move, z jumps, x throws an apple, down drops through

title: Abel's Moving Guy
blurb: A very early one from Abel: a guy he drew that walks around the screen.

title: Animal Power
blurb: One of our first games, from before Claude: I wrote the code from YouTube tutorials and the kids did the art.

title: Dave Digger Bot design notes
blurb: Not a game: Abel's design notes for Dave Digger Bot, typed into the PICO-8 code editor ("he throws chickens at them / the chicken needs to be smaller").
